senses.example: Vivo en un barrio tranquilo de Pamplona.
senses.exampleGloss: I live in a quiet neighbourhood of Pamplona.

alternatives.reason: The middle of the city, not a neighbourhood.
A vaguer word for a part of town.

notes: Masculine; plural barrios. Pamplona has well-known barrios such as Iturrama and San Juan.
